title: Add a retry to the nightly export job

sections.In plain terms: The nightly export sometimes fails on a short network blip and nobody notices until morning.
sections.Context:
* The job ran without a retry for two years.
* Three failures last month, each one a timeout.
sections.Acceptance Criteria:
1. A failed run retries once after five minutes.
2. A second failure pages the on-call person.
